scope: Python BrowserPool typed-result persistence, with the real Grok consumer
prerequisites: Install this checkout and grok-web-connector in the same environment
At least one favorite with created_at; empty accounts fail acceptance

scenario.problem: Successful typed API results must survive checkpointing and restart without repeating completed work.
steps: Save completed results and one held pending job
Close and reopen the pool with the same profiles and checkpoint
Recover only the pending job, preserve completed results, and close owned Chrome instances
scenario.auth: Existing real local credentials; read-only favorites requests
scenario.data_retention: Temporary credential copies, account result checkpoints, and owned profiles removed; only counts and sanitized errors retained

before_fix.regression: Failed: UUID is not JSON serializable
before_fix.live_error: TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable

result.scope: Real Grok BrowserWorkerPool with the Python browser backend
result.operation: read favorites, save pending/completed jobs, reopen and recover

other_attempts.reason: Cleanup file lock masked the baseline failure; temporary files later removed

other_attempts.limitation: Earlier harness did not explicitly require a timestamped favorite

other_attempts.reason: Round 1 typed reads passed; round 2 failed connecting to Chrome with GrokAPIError. Added sanitized cause-chain diagnostics; next complete run passed without lifecycle retries or changed profiles.
other_attempts.follow_up: Intermittent Chrome connection failure remains unisolated; do not infer general lifecycle reliability from the accepted persistence run.

automated_regression.method: Real Pydantic models and production scheduler/state persistence with an in-process fixture client; this test is not browser E2E.
assertions: datetime, UUID, and Decimal retain their JSON values
Completed jobs survive shutdown and are not replayed
Held pending work runs after recovery and final checkpoint has no pending jobs
automated_regression.local_result: 126 passed: tests/unit plus the new persistence regression
automated_regression.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the regression on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows

steering_review.finding: Rule 5 requires JSON-serializable results. Pydantic JSON mode enforces that existing pool contract at the source; no tool names, arguments, or discovery text changed.
steering_review.model_test: No new tool-choice claim is made by this SDK persistence change.

limits: This repairs the Python baseline; it does not migrate Grok to Rust or decide the SDK bridge architecture.
Real authenticated Grok acceptance is local and explicit; hosted CI uses the credential-free regression.
No release, default backend switch, or repository archival.
